title: Relationship Matters
subtitle: 5 Pillars for a Healthy Foundation in ALL Your Relationships
hook: Relationships can bring the greatest joy — and the deepest pain. This course walks you through the five pillars that hold a healthy relational foundation together.
audienceNote: Built for couples, families, and small groups who want to work through the material together at home.
description: Based on my book Relationship Matters, this video series takes you through the five pillars of a healthy relational foundation: Trust, Communication, Authenticity, Honesty, and Honour. Each lesson includes a workbook and a practical challenge so you can build these habits into how you relate to yourself and others.

pillars.title: Trust
pillars.description: The cornerstone pillar. Relationships break under the weight of broken trust — learn how to build trust equity that lasts.

pillars.title: Communication
pillars.description: Healthy communication is how you live out trust day to day and get your relational needs met.

pillars.title: Authenticity
pillars.description: You cannot have a healthy relationship with others until you build one with yourself first.

pillars.title: Honesty
pillars.description: A lost art in today's world. Dishonesty breaks trust and undermines every other pillar.

pillars.title: Honour
pillars.description: Often misunderstood, living with honour has a massive impact on your life and relationships.

results: Build trust equity in your home and relationships
Communicate in ways your needs can be met
Use honesty as a relationship superpower
Reclaim the lost art of honour

testimonial.quote: Relationship Matters is a timely invitation and inspiring guide for living with purpose in relationship with others. In an insightful and practical way, Mark has outlined 5 critical pillars that provide a roadmap for individuals wanting to create a family environment that supports its members to become healthy, content, competent and flourishing adults.
testimonial.author: Dr. Wayne Hammond
credentials: Founding Partner and CSO, Flourishing Life

bullets.text: How to reclaim the lost art of honour

lessons.title: Introduction to Relationship Matters
lessons.body: Welcome to Relationship Matters training course called 5 Pillars of a Healthy Foundation for all your relationships. In this introduction to the course I take you through the foundational teaching that every course I teach is built on. In my experience the more you apply and practice the principles I teach the better the results you will have.

lessons.title: Relationship Matters - Pillar One
lessons.body: Welcome to Pillar 1 - Trust - 5 Pillars of a Healthy Foundation for all your relationships. In Pillar one I teach on the principles of building Trust in your relationships. Trust is the cornerstone of the 5 pillars because relationships will break under the weight of broken trust. Remember to download your workbooks and make lots of notes. There is a relationship challenge at the end of each lesson!

lessons.title: Relationship Matters - Pillar Two
lessons.body:
Welcome to Pillar 2 of Relationship Matters 5 Pillars of a Healthy Foundation for all your relationships. Now that you learned how to build trust one of the best tools for you to live it out is healthy communication! Remember to download your workbook and practice practice practice!!

Welcome to part 2 of Pillar 2 - Communication - 5 Pillars of a Healthy Foundation for all your relationships. In this video we dig a little deeper into communicating in a way that your relational needs can be met. Use the same workbook as the last video.

lessons.title: Relationship Matters – Pillar Three
lessons.body: Welcome to Pillar 3 Authenticity - Relationship Matters, 5 Pillars of a Healthy Foundation for all your relationships. Now that your building trust and communicating well it's time to look inward. You can't really have a healthy relationship with someone else until you build one with yourself. You may have been told in your life to just be yourself, but how can you do that until you know and believe in yourself. Remember to download your workbook.

lessons.title: Relationship Matters – Pillar Four
lessons.body: Welcome to Pillar 4 - Honesty - of the Relationship Matters 4 Pillars of a Healthy Foundation for all your relationships. Honesty is a lost art in today's world, and dishonesty is a relationship killer because it breaks the trust pillar and undermines healthy communications. Enjoy and remember to download your workbook!

lessons.title: Relationship Matters – Pillar Five
lessons.body: Welcome to our last pillar 5 - Honour - Relationship Matters 5 Pillars of a Healthy Foundation for all your relationships. Honour is a lost art and often misunderstood but the power of living a life of honour has a massive impact on your life and relationships! Remember to download your last workbook.
